400.description:
One of the following errors may occur. Errors marked (JSON) are returned as {"Message": "..."}; the others are returned as a plain string.
- `Invalid category ID.`: the request body is missing or cannot be read (plain string), or CustomizableCategoryId is not a customizable category of the connector's latest release (JSON)
- `Account connector not found.` (JSON)
- `Use only Parameters, Object is deprecated`: both Object and Parameters were provided
- `Name must be between 1 and 300 characters`: the deprecated Object is longer than 300 characters
- `Error: Name must be between 1 and 300 characters`: a parameter's Object is empty or longer than 300 characters (JSON)
- `ParameterId is required for each parameter`: a parameter has no ParameterId, or an empty one
- `Duplicate parameter: {id}`: a ParameterId was provided more than once
- `Missing Parameters: {ids}`: the comma-separated IDs of the category's parameters that were not given a value
- `Unknown parameter : {id}`: a ParameterId is not one of the category's parameters
